property_summary: For any caller who is the admin, calling setOwner(x) returns true in the reference contract for every x that does not make the call revert (i.e. admin calls always succeed and return true); the mutant returns false when admin sets owner to address(0), violating this universal return-value rule for that input.
change_summary: Make setOwner return the zero/non-zero check of the new owner address (returns false if address(0), true otherwise) instead of always true.
